architecture_goal.core: Core owns a read-only technical Foundation and independent producers of source-grounded evidence.
architecture_goal.knowledge_layer: KLC composes persisted evidence into knowledge models, cross-fact views, coverage, gaps and capabilities.
architecture_goal.public_core_independence: Public Core analyzers must not depend on outputs of other public analyzers; source-understanding phases may remain internal to one analyzer.
architecture_goal.runner: Runner orchestrates processes and lifecycle but does not define Core internals or knowledge semantics.

decision_policy.base_evidence: keep in Core; Foundation only when it is a reusable technical source index
decision_policy.derived_evidence: keep in Core as independent source-grounded evidence analyzer; remove public analyzer dependencies later
decision_policy.technical_packaging: keep as technical output packaging, not knowledge semantics

known_limits: This map records target ownership decisions but does not alter Core or KLC execution.
Evidence sufficiency for each migration candidate must be proven against real outputs before removal from Core.
Task/Suite orchestration is absent from the installed runtime; parked topology is outside this map.
Performance optimization and duplicate stage elimination are intentionally deferred.

evidence_gaps: KLC currently requires compact/code_conceptual_model artifacts from Core for repository data-model materialization.
The raw evidence families used by the current Core materializer must be enumerated and proven sufficient before removing that artifact.
Result parity must be checked on real repositories before the Core materializer is deleted.

stage_responsibilities.rationale: Assembles a canonical conceptual/physical model from many previously extracted facts and schema artifacts.
Builds compact navigation and machine-first package files from already materialized facts.
Extracts source-declared configuration values without business interpretation.
Writes the slim repository metadata part of the analysis-output contract.
Parses user-supplied data-evidence.yaml as declared evidence input.
Extracts confirmed physical schema declarations from schema-bearing sources.
Extracts explicitly declared value sets without semantic reference-data classification.
Builds bounded summaries of observed declared value sets without semantic classification.
Writes coverage, limitations and source-type metadata for the output contract.
Extracts source-declared Gradle modules and dependencies.
Builds deterministic source-to-sink flow evidence from Java syntax.
Ranks observed repository signals into a data-model analysis candidate profile; it does not build the model.
Extracts attribute occurrences, mappings, derivations and lineage gaps from code; it may reuse persistence facts.
Builds local and interprocedural field-flow observations.
Resolves neutral source-to-storage and storage-access lineage from code evidence.
Publishes universal source observations and a full observation store; optional framework interpretation is still evidence-oriented.
Extracts Tree-sitter Java structural facts, schemas, interfaces and direct relations.
Composes local HTTP/configuration boundary evidence from direct configuration and interface observations.
Produces observed JPA/jOOQ relationship and key-usage facts without declaring physical keys or business cardinality.
Builds ingress/call/persistence trace evidence from source files and data-flow facts.
Extracts source-declared Maven dependencies.
Writes normalized fact indexes from already materialized facts.
Extracts declared OpenAPI/Swagger interfaces and schemas.
Deterministically prepares declared-value and literal-write observations for reference-data-evidence/v1; KLC owns persistence and query semantics.
Discovers repository files and stack signals used by all later scanners.
Discovers supplied specification and supporting evidence artifacts.
Transforms parsed specification evidence into the standard analysis-output compatibility contract.
Extracts SQL statements and parse diagnostics from repository files.

what_moves_to_klc: system interface and scenario query surfaces
what_stays_in_core: observed interface, scenario, configuration, dependency and storage-access evidence extraction

stage_responsibilities.rationale: Deterministically prepares observed interface, scenario, dependency and access evidence for system-description-evidence/v1; KLC owns persistence and query semantics.
